title: SHP® — Optically Pumped Magnetometry
description: Park Seonghyeon. Research in optically pumped magnetometry — optical design, vapour-cell atomic physics, parametric CAD, and a supervised validation pipeline.

hero.lede: Reading the precession of atoms with light — and recording where every value came from alongside it.
hero.alt: A sealed glass vapour cell drawn as four-tone pixel art

about.say: The precession of an atom is exactly proportional to the field it sits in. Read that frequency with light and the magnetometer is referred to a constant of nature rather than to a scale someone engraved.

rows.p: Beam path, polarisation and detection angle are settled first; the hardware is fitted to them afterwards.
rows.alt: Pixel icon of a prism and a beamsplitter cube

rows.p: Vapour pressure, buffer gas, resonance linewidth — the values the inside of the cell decides.
rows.alt: Pixel icon of a sealed vapour cell with a tip-off stem

rows.p: A dimension that appears as a bare number in three places is a bug.
rows.alt: Isometric pixel icon of a machined block with a bolt circle

rows.p: A measured value and an assumed one never get written in the same column.
rows.alt: Pixel icon of a matched pair of detectors

rows.p: Whoever built it does not certify it. A pass is not an opinion.
rows.alt: Pixel icon of a grid of parts with one cell empty
